title: The Pink and Green Friendsgiving Kitchen Island Spread
description: A pink and green Friendsgiving spread: a pink gingham ruffle runner, a jadeite cake stand, a pink mason jar pitcher, green glass dessert cups, pumpkin salt and pepper shakers and gold-foil scalloped napkins.
intro: Last year I hosted Friendsgiving with mismatched paper plates and a pitcher that dribbled down everyone's sleeve, so this year I went full pink. The gingham ruffle runner went down the island, the jadeite cake stand got the pumpkin cake, and the pink mason jar pitcher held lemonade that did not dribble once. The little pumpkin salt and pepper shakers got more compliments than my stuffing, which, rude, but fair.

sections.heading: Start with the runner
paragraphs: A pink gingham ruffle table runner, 13 by 72 inches, covers a kitchen island and sets the whole colour story.

sections.heading: Jadeite and green glass
paragraphs: The Martha Stewart Highbrook 11 inch jadeite cake stand holds the dessert, and a set of four green vintage pressed glass dessert cups takes mousse, pudding or a scoop of pie.

sections.heading: The little pink extras
paragraphs: A taffy pink 2 quart mason jar pitcher, pink and white pumpkin salt and pepper shakers, and a 100 pack of pink scalloped cocktail napkins with gold foil finish it.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, food, furniture and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
